questions.question: A 34-year-old man with muscle stiffness and weakness is diagnosed with myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1). DNA analysis shows a CTG repeat expansion of 200 repeats in the 3' untranslated region of the DMPK gene. His mother had mild cataracts diagnosed at age 60, while his newborn daughter has severe congenital myotonic dystrophy with hypotonia and respiratory failure. Which molecular mechanism accounts for the increased clinical severity and earlier age of onset in the daughter?
options: Increased hypermethylation of the paternal allele during spermatogenesis
Expansion of the CTG repeat length during maternal gametogenesis
Somatic recombination resulting in loss of heterozygosity in the embryo
Revertant mosaicism in tissues with high metabolic turnover

questions.question: A female carrier of a balanced Robertsonian translocation involving chromosomes 13 and 14 [45,XX,der(13;14)(q10;q10)] becomes pregnant. Assuming adjacent segregation occurs during meiosis, which of the following chromosomal abnormalities is most likely to result in a liveborn infant?

A 5-year-old boy presents with marked photosensitivity, poikiloderma, and multiple actinic keratoses on sun-exposed skin. A skin biopsy reveals impaired repair of UV-induced cyclobutane pyrimidine dimers. Which DNA repair pathway is specifically disrupted in this patient?

A 12-month-old infant presents with severe developmental delay, absence of speech, unprovoked outbursts of laughter, microcephaly, and an ataxic gait. Cytogenetic and molecular testing reveals a microdeletion of the maternal chromosome 15q11.2-q13 region. Absence of expression of which gene, normally expressed exclusively from the maternal allele in brain tissue, causes this patient's phenotype?

A child diagnosed with cystic fibrosis undergoes full-gene sequencing of the CFTR gene. Results reveal the p.Phe508del variant on the maternally inherited allele and the p.Gly551D variant on the paternally inherited allele. Neither parent exhibits signs or symptoms of cystic fibrosis. Which genetic term accurately describes the genotype of this patient?
